meta.title: Fix syntax highlighting flicker by replacing PrismAsyncLight with Shiki
meta.body_summary: Replaced react-syntax-highlighter with Shiki to fix syntax highlighting flicker in reasoning slide-out component by using synchronous highlighting.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced PrismAsyncLight with Shiki to fix flicker; initial implementation had type safety and error handling issues flagged by bot; human maintainer heavily edited the branch with many commits focusing on proper transpilation, line numbers, and token loading before merging.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 13446 changed lines across 199 files, this is a large-scale refactor by absolute volume, but much of the churn comes from merging staging (bringing in many unrelated changes); the core syntax highlight change is concentrated in a few files (~500 lines). The PR resulted in a merged fix after extensive human rework.

review_details.concern_detail: Greptile bot flagged: highlighterInstance typed as any, isReady set to true even on error, unused isDarkMode prop, and typo 'magneta5'.
review_details.performance_claim: Replace async PrismAsyncLight with synchronous Shiki to eliminate flicker.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Replacing a core UI library with async considerations and theme conversion challenged the agent; initial code required significant human intervention to handle transpilation, SSR, and line numbers.
success_factors: maintainer took over and fixed implementation
bot review provided early quality signals

detection_detail.code_reading: Greptile bot identified type safety and error handling issues via automated code analysis.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Vercel preview deployments were used to verify the build and visual correctness.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes test plan but no performance evidence; Vercel deployment succeeded after fixes.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Maintainer added commits for line numbers, proper transpilation, custom hook for token loading, and merged after multiple iterations.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced react-syntax-highlighter with Shiki in SyntaxHighlighter component, added shiki-light-theme.ts, removed react-syntax-highlighter dependency, and updated pnpm-lock.yaml. Multiple follow-up commits by maintainer added proper line numbers, transpilation, token loading, and font family fallbacks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: 199 files changed overall due to merges; core PR changes focused on SyntaxHighlight folder (~500 lines).
change_trajectory: Initial Devin commit: replaced PrismAsyncLight with Shiki, added theme, removed dependency.
Merge staging (multiple times) to stay up-to-date.

Maintainer commits: 'move to shiki', 'accept line numbers', 'shiki with proper transpilation', 'more props for container', 'custom hook for token loading', 'Update SyntaxHighlighter.tsx', 'font family fallback'.
Final merge after multiple force-pushes and Vercel deploys.
